name: Trade / Geopolitical Risk / Capital-flow Transmission contract

objects: actual tariff/customs collection or trade-flow realization
TRADE_POLICY_EVENT.guard: Announcement, legal effectiveness and realized trade flow are separate clocks.

EXPORT_CONTROL_EVENT.guard: BIS rules may have different effective/compliance structures. Never infer effective time from press-release time alone.

SANCTIONS_EVENT.guard: Legal blocking state, license exceptions and market exposure must be separated.

GEOPOLITICAL_RISK_STATE.guard: News-based risk/intensity state is not a legal-policy event and not a directional trading signal.

REAL_TRADE_FLOW.guard: Realized trade data are lagged outcomes of policy, demand and supply-chain adaptation; not same-clock policy shocks.

CAPITAL_FLOW.guard: Trading flow, balance-of-payments flow and cross-border portfolio holdings are different objects/frequencies.

eventClockContract.unknownRule: Absent legal/publication/effective timestamp => UNKNOWN; do not use announcement date as substitute.
eventClockContract.versionRule: Amendments, exclusions, licenses, removals and delayed implementation create new versions; never overwrite prior event state.

TWSE_FOREIGN_TRADING.meaning: Same-market trading activity by foreign-investor categories; not equivalent to cross-border balance-of-payments capital movement.
TWSE_FOREIGN_TRADING.decision1810Guard: At 18:10, data availability/coverage differs by product/version. A 19:40 or 20:00 full version is future. Exact source entitlement and production receipt must be preserved.
TWSE_FOREIGN_TRADING.blockTradeGuard: Excluding-block and including-block versions are different objects, not revisions of one silently overwritten record.

TAIWAN_BOP.meaning: Quarterly external-account flows including direct/portfolio/other investment; structural capital-flow regime, not daily trading signal.
TAIWAN_BOP.source: Central Bank of the Republic of China (Taiwan)
TAIWAN_BOP.releaseGuard: Preserve reference quarter, 16:20 scheduled release time and vintage/revisions. Current revised history is not a daily first-known series.

US_TIC.lag: Monthly releases have about a 1.5-month lag between release and as-of date.
US_TIC.revisionGuard: January/April/July/October releases revise prior year; other monthly releases revise prior three months per Treasury release policy.
US_TIC.useGuard: Structural/global capital-flow state only unless a lower-frequency experiment is explicitly designed.

GPR.definition: News-based measure of adverse geopolitical events and associated risks; includes threat and realization/acts components.
GPR.prohibited: GPR high = Taiwan equities down, or GPR low = risk-on, without exposure/regime/incremental tests.

TPU.definition: Trade-policy uncertainty measures based on news/firm communications/tariff-related uncertainty.
TPU.mechanism: Uncertainty can delay investment/production/hiring and reduce activity, but does not identify winner/loser sectors by itself.
TPU.guard: Uncertainty shock != tariff level != legal effective action.

transmissionChannels: Taiwan foreign-investor trading and FX feedback

taiwanOwnershipBoundary.D13: policy/legal clocks, global geopolitical/uncertainty state, cross-border/market flow state, source/vintage/provenance, macro transmission
taiwanOwnershipBoundary.D10_D07: company/industry supply-chain exposure, customer/product dependence, beneficiary/victim mapping, substitution/capacity/inventory
taiwanOwnershipBoundary.D05: institutional/chip/ETF trading-flow microstructure where already owned; D13 may consume validated aggregate state but must not duplicate maturity

fragmentationEvidenceGuard.finding: Research literature supports geopolitical fragmentation/diversion in some trade/FDI/portfolio relationships, but effects are targeted/sector- and country-pair-dependent rather than universal.
fragmentationEvidenceGuard.implication: Do not build one global 'deglobalization score'.

falsification: policy event versus contemporaneous VIX/USD/rates/global equity controls
trade diversion/connector-country alternative to simple lost-trade hypothesis
TWSE foreign trading versus CBC BOP portfolio flow non-equivalence
same geopolitical event with opposite sector exposures
event clustering and overlapping sanctions/export controls/tariffs
no event severity or exposure threshold chosen after returns

maturityDecision.reason: Policy/legal/flow objects, clocks, capital-flow semantics, geopolitical-risk measurement, Taiwan dependency boundary and falsification are frozen; no Taiwan prospective/OOS evidence for L3.

exactNext: Freeze one official trade/export-control/sanctions event receipt with announcement/legal/effective clocks and version lineage.
Audit one TWSE foreign-flow product at the 18:10 clock, preserving ex-block vs incl-block version and source entitlement.
Preserve CBC BOP and U.S. TIC as lower-frequency structural flow vintages; do not mix with daily foreign trading.
Build event-exposure schema linking D13 event state to D10/D07 validated sector/company exposure without duplicating exposure research.
Only after independent PIT events/dates exist, test Taiwan gap/MAE/sector-residual outcomes; Formal remains locked.
